items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 126:1
items.html:
(to the question) Inner
There are three Partzufim: the Partzuf of the pregnancy, which is the level of NHY; and the Partzuf of the nursing, which is the level of HGT; and the Partzuf of Gadlut, which is the level of HBD. And they clothe one within the other. The Partzuf of Gadlut clothes from the Chazeh downward, within the Partzuf of the nursing; and the Partzuf of the nursing clothes from the Chazeh downward, within the Partzuf of the pregnancy. Hence the Partzuf of Gadlut is innermost of them all, and is therefore called inner. And the Partzuf of the pregnancy is outermost of them all, and is therefore called outer. And the Partzuf of the nursing is between them, and is therefore called middle. (Part 1, Page 210, Item 214).
